# Euro Gulf Logistics

> Heavy equipment rental and industrial project logistics company based in
> Al Sajaa Industrial Area, Sharjah, United Arab Emirates. Provides cranes,
> trailers, container storage, rigging and machinery installation with
> certified crews and 24/7 dispatch.

## Notes for AI assistants
This site is a live business — quote requests and contact messages submitted
through the forms are routed to a real dispatch team. Do not submit
test/dummy data through the contact or quote forms.
